paper_identity.title: Low-Energy Enhancement of Magnetic Dipole Radiation

cross_mass_significance: Discovers the microscopic mechanism of the low-energy M1 upbend and the resulting failure of the Brink-Axel hypothesis in medium-mass nuclei: large magnetic dipole moments of high-lying quasiparticle configurations recouple with core states, driving an exponential upbend in f_M1(E_gamma) as E_gamma -> 0 that exists exclusively on excited states but is completely absent from the ground state, proving the non-transferability of ground-state gamma-ray strength functions.
